verdict.rationale: USCIS offers a sanctioned API surface (the Torch platform's Case Status API and FOIA Request/Status API, with developer accounts, sandbox, and production keys), so some UI functions such as checking case status and FOIA requests can be done by machine. The core UI actions have no API counterpart: the docs state there is no filing API and that myUSCIS is the only online filing rail, and online fee payment, address change, and G-28 representation filing are documented only in the web account. Missing for 10: form filing API, fee payment API, address change API, G-28/representative filing API, account management API, and any documented commitment to API–UI parity.
